name: studio-x-plugins
description: STUDIO X — all plugins in one place. Pick what you need based on role and team.

plugins.name: sx-core
plugins.description: STUDIO X developer toolkit — 89 skills + 11 feature-templates, 40 agents, 3 hooks. Claude Code only — project management skills moved to sx-pm. Pair with sx-qa for testing.

plugins.name: sx-qa
plugins.description: Shared QA toolkit for STUDIO X and Pettersson Apps — 10 skills, 3 agents, 2 hooks, plus Maestro and Playwright MCP servers for testing Expo, PWA, and web. Recommended companion to sx-core.

plugins.name: sx-pm
plugins.description: STUDIO X project management toolkit — 16 bilingual (NO + EN) skills for kickoff, planning, status reporting, milestone tracking, risk assessment, change requests, retrospectives, tech/functional specs, and estimation format. For PMs, leaders, sales, and developers. Recommended for everyone.

plugins.name: sx-business
plugins.description: STUDIO X Norwegian sales and delivery skills — 19 skills for proposals, estimation, client templates (Word/Excel/PPTX/GSheet), Tripletex billing, sales meetings, lead qualification, and design preproject. STUDIO X Norway team only.

plugins.name: pa-business
plugins.description: Partner business toolkit — 24 English skills for partner teams (Pettersson Apps). Estimation in T-shirt sizes, project management, proposals, templates.

plugins.name: sx-leadership
plugins.description: STUDIO X leadership pricing system — 5 RESTRICTED skills for size→kr conversion, polish/QA phase pricing, and proposal generation. Leadership and sales only.
